About Me

Data-driven, creative and curious.

I’m a digital marketing professional with one year of experience across SEO, SEM and social media marketing. I started with a six-month digital marketing internship, then worked as an SEO Specialist at AV Infotechnologies.

I enjoy finding what’s holding a website back and turning it into a clear action list. I track results using Google Analytics and Search Console. I’m now looking to grow in an SEO or Digital Marketing role that improves website visibility, organic traffic and leads.
